audit: tool page desktop layout visual regression fix

findings.issue: Vue tool root was a direct child of the tool-page CSS grid but did not span all columns, so JSON/MD5 workbench rendered in the first half-column and collapsed to a narrow mobile-like card.
findings.fix: Added v50 CSS override making .ymir-page[data-ymir-tool] > .ymir-vue-tool-root span grid-column 1 / -1 with width:100% and max-width:none.

findings.issue: Input/output panels and action toolbar inherited width from the collapsed grid item, causing vertical textarea columns and cramped buttons.
findings.fix: Hardened .ymir-vue-body/.ymir-vue-grid two-column desktop layout, min-width:0 on panels, and flex wrapping action toolbar.

findings.issue: Tool workbench header contained a second language toggle, consuming header width and worsening title wrapping.
findings.fix: renderToolHeader now shows the internal language toggle only when showLanguageToggle === true; the existing topbar language toggle remains the page-level control.
